dedupe_keys.name: nonductile rc moment frames automated nonlinear dynamic analysis and fragility generation

description: This DesignSafe project provides models, nonlinear dynamic analyses and fragility functions for nonductile reinforced concrete moment-resisting frames, a collapse-prone building type, with an approach that automates model building without significant loss of accuracy in predicting collapse and other damage states. It was published on DesignSafe in 2023 by Peng-Yu Chen, Nikolaos Lesgidis, Anastasios Sextos and Ertugrul Taciroglu. The authors aim to support regional risk and loss assessment by letting property owners, engineers and officials quickly develop building models and analyse their response to scenario or historical earthquakes. Coverage: nonductile reinforced concrete frame buildings; the region studied is not named in the metadata read. Access: DesignSafe Data Depot. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: file contents and formats were not listed in the metadata read. Simulation uses: fragility inputs and automated structural models for regional seismic loss of older concrete buildings. Related records: INSSEPT and the Los Angeles woodframe case study.
